summary: This sheet consolidates incoming GPU capacity requests for June 2026 planning. It prioritizes by technical urgency and product impact and includes approval state to guide short-term allocation decisions. Critical items include quant-tuning (REQ-2026-117) and release load-tests (REQ-2026-159). Several region-specific requests (asia-northeast1, europe-west1) require cross-team coordination for placements.

notes: Guidance: prefer matching accelerator class where possible, otherwise fallback to nearest compatible region and flag potential QoE impacts.
